# Payments API reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/api_reference.py from contracts/http; do not edit. -->

Provider-independent payment ledger, captures, refunds and provider workers. Contract version 1.0.0, generated from [`contracts/http/payments.openapi.json`](../../contracts/http/payments.openapi.json). 15 HTTP operations, 8 MCP tools. [All components](README.md) · [Build your first app](../build-your-first-app.md).

<div class="docs-try-config"></div>

## Set up a client

Every example below uses these three values. `VEYNDO_TOKEN` is needed only for merchant operations; keep it on your server.

```sh
export VEYNDO_URL=https://api.veyndo.ai
export VEYNDO_SHOP=<your-shop-id>
export VEYNDO_TOKEN=<personal-session-or-integration-key>
```

<div class="docs-examples" markdown="1">

<p class="docs-example-label">curl</p>

```sh
curl -fsS "$VEYNDO_URL/health"
```

<p class="docs-example-label">TypeScript</p>

```typescript
import { Auth, VeyndoClient } from "@veyndo/commerce-client";

const client = new VeyndoClient({
  baseUrl: process.env.VEYNDO_URL!,
  tenant: process.env.VEYNDO_SHOP,
  auth: process.env.VEYNDO_TOKEN ? Auth.personalSession(process.env.VEYNDO_TOKEN) : undefined,
});
```

<p class="docs-example-label">Python</p>

```python
import os
from veyndo_sdk import Auth, VeyndoClient

token = os.environ.get("VEYNDO_TOKEN")
client = VeyndoClient(os.environ["VEYNDO_URL"], tenant=os.environ["VEYNDO_SHOP"],
                      auth=Auth.personal_session(token) if token else None)
```

<p class="docs-example-label">Rust</p>

```rust
use serde_json::json;
use veyndo_sdk::{Auth, Client, ClientOptions, RequestOptions};

let client = Client::new(ClientOptions {
    base_url: std::env::var("VEYNDO_URL")?,
    tenant: std::env::var("VEYNDO_SHOP").ok(),
    auth: std::env::var("VEYNDO_TOKEN").ok().map(Auth::PersonalSession),
    ..ClientOptions::default()
});
```

</div>

The `payments` API object, method names and argument order are those of the generated [SDKs](../sdks.md).

## MCP tools

Called with JSON-RPC `tools/call` on `POST /mcp`. The facts come from the [typed operations graph](../business-capabilities.md#the-typed-operations-graph); the server validates the input schema before it runs a tool.

### `checkout.payment.instructions` {: #tool-checkout-payment-instructions }

Read recipient instructions for the original customer checkout.

| Fact | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Audience | shopper |
| Writes | no |
| Risk | medium |
| Reversibility | reversible |
| Requires approval | no |
| Cost | free |
| Permissions | none |
| Effects | none |
| Conditions | none |
| Data | payment, order · money · pii |
| Requires | none |

| Argument | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes |

<p class="docs-try-note">A shopper read. Browsers on other origins cannot call <code>POST /mcp</code> (it accepts only the shop&#39;s own origin); copy the request into your agent, server or terminal.</p>

<div class="docs-examples" markdown="1">

<p class="docs-example-label">curl</p>

```sh
curl -fsS -X POST "$VEYNDO_URL/mcp" \
  -H "x-tenant: $VEYNDO_SHOP" \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  --data '{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "checkout.payment.instructions", "arguments": {"id": "<string>"}}}'
```

<p class="docs-example-label">TypeScript</p>

```typescript
const result = await client.mcp.call("checkout.payment.instructions", {"id": "<string>"});
```

<p class="docs-example-label">Python</p>

```python
result = client.mcp.call("checkout.payment.instructions", {"id": "<string>"})
```

<p class="docs-example-label">Rust</p>

```rust
let result = client.mcp().call_raw("checkout.payment.instructions", json!({"id": "<string>"})).await?;
```

</div>

### `checkout.payment.method.revoke` {: #tool-checkout-payment-method-revoke }

Revoke the owning customer saved method and queue provider cleanup.

| Fact | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Audience | shopper |
| Writes | yes |
| Risk | high |
| Reversibility | irreversible |
| Requires approval | yes |
| Cost | provider |
| Permissions | none |
| Effects | externalCall, backgroundJob, event |
| Conditions | none |
| Data | payment · pii |
| Requires | `checkout.payment.methods` |

| Argument | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `approve` | boolean | yes |
| `id` | string | yes |
| `requestKey` | string | yes |

<p class="docs-try-note">A write. Not executed from the docs. Try it in a <a href="../build-your-first-app.md#deploy-to-a-private-sandbox">private sandbox</a>.</p>

<div class="docs-examples" markdown="1">

<p class="docs-example-label">curl</p>

### `merchant.payment` {: #tool-merchant-payment }

Explicitly approved idempotent provider command.

| Fact | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Audience | merchant |
| Writes | yes |
| Risk | high |
| Reversibility | irreversible |
| Requires approval | yes |
| Cost | provider |
| Permissions | `payments.manage` |
| Effects | payment, externalCall, event |
| Conditions | none |
| Data | payment, order · money |
| Requires | `merchant.payment.details` |

| Argument | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `amountMinor` | integer (≥ 1) | no |
| `approve` | boolean | yes |
| `captureId` | string | no |
| `finalCapture` | boolean | no |
| `id` | string | yes |
| `operation` | `"capture"` \| `"authorize"` \| `"void"` \| `"refund"` \| `"reconcile"` \| `"cancel"` | yes |
| `requestKey` | string | yes |

<p class="docs-try-note">A write. Not executed from the docs. Try it in a <a href="../build-your-first-app.md#deploy-to-a-private-sandbox">private sandbox</a>.</p>

<div class="docs-examples" markdown="1">

```sh
  -H "x-tenant: $VEYNDO_SHOP" \
  -H "authorization: Bearer $VEYNDO_TOKEN" \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  --data '{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "merchant.payment", "arguments": {"id": "<string>", "operation": "capture", "requestKey": "<string>", "approve": false}}}'
```
